rationale: PINS the #841 round-14 suppression in a HEALTHY class (the recovery fixture pins the degraded case). `{ Test left, Test right -> }` parses as juxt_function_call(name: Test, args: left, Test) plus a lambda_expression, and before round 14 the juxt branch emitted a fabricated `calls` edge whose target is the parameter TYPE — here measured on the baseline analyzer as `calls -> Test @16`, absent after. The two positive edges are load-bearing in the other direction: `sortByName -> sort` proves the juxt's own method call survives the suppression, and `inspectEach -> register` proves the closure BODY still walks. Corpus-wide evidence for the rule: 962 such juxt sites across grails-core and geb, 613 fabricated edges removed (589 while the site fired, 24 re-parented), 0 unexplained, 0 sites where the guard's evidence failed (reviews/m59-841-assert-comma-separator.md §7r).
